selection_rule: Use the existing narrowly matched Two Sum proposal on the standard lexicographic nested-loop implementation; choose sizes to force the original scan to find the pair near the end, before collecting counts.
problem_statement: Given an integer array nums and an integer target, return the indices of two distinct numbers whose sum equals target, or an empty array if there is no pair.
benchmark_input_rule: For each size n, pass list(range(n)) and target 2*n-3, forcing the first valid pair to be the last two indices.
claim_limit: Operation-count comparison on one preselected Two Sum input family; not wall-clock speedup, asymptotic proof, or general optimizer accuracy.
